method: Read670 additional contiguous lines: Markdown measure/paint, surrogate decoder and word navigation. Static layout callgraph analysis only.
findings: Heading measurement selects font_h and measures joined plain text via wrap_text_height, adding level offset plus4. Heading paint selects font_h initially but calls paint_run_lines/layout_runs, which chooses font_c/font_n/font_code by inline kind, not heading font; paint also omits measured final4. Shared block parser does not guarantee matching measured/drawn heading geometry.

layout_runs selects MD_LINK for Link but discards _color, stores no link/color in MdFrag, and paint chooses only code-vs-body color. Links render as ordinary body-colored label; no link hit target in these helpers. Earlier markdown parser label-only limitation now traced to renderer.
Italic uses same body font; Bold uses result-title font, whose weight is user-configurable rather than guaranteed bold. These are source rendering choices; no screenshots or typography acceptance.

Inline wrapping splits only ASCII space, not newline or general Unicode whitespace. Long words are not split; renderer uses DT_SINGLELINE per fragment, so width/line-break behavior is limited. No actual GDI fixture.
Inline-code background adds10 pixels width but layout advancement reserves only text width, so chip padding can overlap neighbors. This is source geometry finding, not measured visual corruption.

wm_char_decode explicitly combines high/low UTF16 surrogates, drops lone low and clears pending on ordinary scalar. Correct implementation shape does not replace actual Windows WM_CHAR runtime or original tests.

word_left/right clamp to string length but assume char boundary before slicing; delete_word_before first floors boundary, while prior navigation callers rely on cursor invariant. No invalid-cursor reachability established.

Code block measurement and painting duplicate matching DrawText flags/minimum18 and padding arithmetic; ordinary paragraphs share layout_runs between measure/paint. Heading inconsistency must not be generalized to all blocks.
Repeated measure/paint parsing and allocation exist but no timing benchmark or accepted optimization. No local dedup production change justified from launcher drawing.
limits: No new runtime tests, GDI rendering, browser, model or user-data actions.
